It is possible that CMY\'s Miss Cox is the same as the Agnes Cox who published Zenza and Ounah, the Indian sisters, and other poems (Windermere: Johnson 1887). Miss Cox evidently knew the author of \'The Cardioscope\', an early series in MP, and perhaps that was written by [Harriet Lucy Cox](/person/375), who is a probable early contributor. However, there is little substantial evidence here.
